disposition_reason: The original six-speed decoding task is ordered, but complete Figure 2h/4d,e accuracy matrices, original split realizations and exact figure-producing settings are not recovered. The source correctly uses different within-time and cross-time CV protocols. The existing chronological pooled-state protocol changes source splits and input permissions and remains an extension.

source_paper.title: Flexible neural population dynamics govern the speed and stability of sensory encoding in mouse visual cortex

evidence.locator: Results Figures 2h and 4d,e; Methods: Independent-neuron decoding of binned spike counts, Cross-time decoding of binned spike counts; equation 21. Methods cross-time text internally calls the panel Figure 5d,e.
evidence.supports: Original six-speed state-specific decoding in five mice: diagonal-covariance within-time three-fold CV versus cross-time two-fold CV with five repeats; relative-generalization equation.

evidence.locator: normal state criteria; unit filtering; options.kfold=3; GammaOpt/GammaOne sections
evidence.supports: Normal state criteria, unit filtering, within-time three-fold CV and GammaOne diagonal-covariance route consistent with the original independent-neuron decoder; exact run configuration still needs authentication.
State/trial/unit eligibility and two-way random splits with five repetitions; these match the source cross-time split design. Exact subsampling and saved run membership require binding.
Prediction accuracy is proportion correct, averaged over folds, with per-class accuracy also returned.

evidence.locator: version 1 metadata; code link and sole data archive
evidence.supports: Versioned preprocessed Horrocks et al. 2024 data deposit; no payload or labels inspected.

target.description: Decode one of six visual speeds from V1 activity within each behavioral state; retain within-time accuracy and the original cross-time generalization endpoints.

dataset.description: Figshare 26031226 version 1, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.26031226.v1, paired with the publication-tag code snapshot.

cohort.description: The five primary mice and their original sessions; the separate Allen extension is outside this registered scope. Retain all qualifying state/class cells.

split.description: Within-time Figure 2h uses random stratified three-fold CV repeated five times, diagonal covariance and inner five-fold delta tuning. Cross-time uses half train/half test, five repeats, nonoverlapping 100 ms windows and inner five-fold gamma/delta tuning. The source/code two-fold cross-time design agrees; actual memberships, seeds and figure-producing population settings remain unbound.

inputs.description: Binned V1 spike-count vectors, with stationary and locomotion analyses fitted separately as in the paper. Removing state dispatch or pooling states changes the information condition.

preprocessing.description: Source normal state criteria, full-contrast 573-dot trials, duration tolerance, minimum trial balancing and quality/rate unit filters are retained. Source uses isi_viol<=0.1, amplitude_cutoff<=0.1, amplitude>=50 and dm_fr>=1. Within-time windows are 100 ms wide at 10 ms steps; cross-time windows are nonoverlapping 100 ms.

metric.description: Accuracy = correct predictions / test trials; chance is 1/6. Equation 21 separately normalizes cross-time accuracy above chance by within-time accuracy above chance.

aggregation.description: Keep every original state/train-time/test-time cell and source repeat/mouse weighting. No validated single source-paper aggregate or full numeric matrix has been recovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Original state-specific six-class accuracy and Figure 4 cross-time generalization

published_baseline.description: Full Figure 2h/4d accuracy matrices are unrecovered. Figure 4e reports relative cross-time performance stationary 0.25 +/- 0.04 and locomotion 0.58 +/- 0.07 (SEM, five mice); preserve this state vector without inventing a scalar accuracy baseline. Chance 1/6 is only a sanity check.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No complete author rerun with original memberships/settings and authenticated figure output exists. The two-fold cross-time script is consistent with the paper; frozen-coefficient transport establishes neither the original MATLAB reference nor its numerical scores.

minimum_effect.rationale: Requires task-specific accuracy improvement and protected retention of cross-time behavior after recovering the baseline; neither stronger state effects nor the chronological extension’s balanced-accuracy delta supplies the margin.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired mouse-level uncertainty with original repeats retained as repeated measurements, and a fixed rule covering both state/time endpoints.
uncertainty.rationale: Windows, trials and CV repeats must not inflate biological replication; no ungrounded alpha or minimum delta is imposed.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact figure-producing MATLAB settings, original partitions and full accuracy matrices, preserving the distinct within-time and cross-time source protocols.
Compare source-author LDA and candidate on the same five-mouse, state-specific, six-speed task with unchanged features and trial support.
Retain both within-time and cross-time endpoints; a favorable time cell or smaller neuron subset is insufficient.
The pooled-state chronological calibration extension and its local LDA baselines cannot claim a source-paper win.
Freeze candidate method, meaningful effect, paired uncertainty and concrete budgets before final source-task evaluation.
Preserve original cross-time and within-time scores; increasing the relative-performance ratio by degrading its within-time denominator is not scientific improvement.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; source-paper reproduction and same-task improvement are separate outcomes.

episode.improvement_loop: Disabled until source baseline and partition identity are resolved; later optimization uses only the corresponding original train/development data.
episode.candidate_freeze: Hash candidate and tuning policy before final accuracy matrices are released.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate complete original state/time/class support against the authenticated paper route; no replacement with a convenient chronological split.
episode.baseline_policy: Source-paper, rerun author and candidate scores remain separate. Coefficient transport and newly authored pooled-state LDA are calibration/extension components. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Complete Figure 2h/4d accuracy matrices and executable original aggregation remain unrecovered; the reported Figure 4e state vector is not a substitute scalar baseline.

Exact saved random memberships, source seeds, population-subsampling settings and authenticated paper-producing configuration require recovery; no two-fold versus three-fold source contradiction is claimed.
No complete same-task evaluator/reference, meaningful effect, uncertainty rule or fixed budgets.

legacy.notes: The original reconstruction contract and frozen-decoder component remain calibration only. The prior chronological improvement proposal remains separately labelled extension evidence.
